import json,sys,os,time,pathlib
ready=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[4]);go=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[5]);deadline=float(sys.argv[6])
ready.open('x').write(json.dumps({'pid':os.getpid()})+chr(10))
while not go.exists():
 if time.time()>=deadline:raise TimeoutError('Synthetic admission barrier expired')
 time.sleep(.05)
from paper.scripts.run_titans_mac_accuracy9 import synthetic_condition
c=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));print(json.dumps(synthetic_condition(c,sys.argv[2],'log_mse',arm=sys.argv[3]),allow_nan=False))
